TC-21/S23.title: Step 1 visit cadence and vitals/meds cadence per context
TC-21/S23.detail: Not testable: there is no written definition of 'correct' cadence per context (Q7). Partial oracles are elsewhere: hospital day / visit number on the cards (TC-01; B23: Hospital cards show no hospital day and NH cards no visit number), the NH 'Visit N – date' timeline (seen in S26: 'Visit 1 – Oct 16: …'), retention windows (S17, todo).
